# Discrete running example

```{r}
P <- matrix(c(.20, .10, .05,
              .15, .20, .10,
              .05, .05, .10), 3, byrow = TRUE,
            dimnames = list(x = 0:2, y = 0:2))
x <- 0:2; y <- 0:2
px <- rowSums(P); py <- colSums(P)
```

## Conditional PMF and independence check

```{r}
P[, "2"] / py["2"]                    # p_{X|Y}(x | 2)
max(abs(P - outer(px, py)))           # > 0: not independent
```

## Expectation, covariance, correlation

```{r}
EX <- sum(x * px); EY <- sum(y * py)
EXY <- sum(outer(x, y) * P)           # E[XY]
vx <- sum(x^2 * px) - EX^2; vy <- sum(y^2 * py) - EY^2
cov_xy <- EXY - EX * EY
c(EXY = EXY, cov = cov_xy, rho = cov_xy / sqrt(vx * vy))
vx + vy + 2 * cov_xy                  # Var(X + Y)
```

# Continuous running example: f(x, y) = exp(-y), 0 < x < y

```{r}
set.seed(14)
y <- rgamma(1e5, 2, 1); x <- runif(1e5, 0, y)
c(cov = cov(x, y), cor = cor(x, y), theory = 1 / sqrt(2))
var(x + y)                            # theory: 1 + 2 + 2 = 5
```

# Zero correlation does not mean independence

```{r}
x <- runif(1e5, -1, 1); y <- x^2
cor(x, y)                             # approximately 0
mean(x > 0.9 & y < 0.5)               # exactly 0
mean(x > 0.9) * mean(y < 0.5)         # about 0.035 if independent
plot(x[1:1000], y[1:1000], pch = 16, cex = .5, xlab = "x", ylab = "y")
```

# Variance of sums: binomial

```{r}
n <- 10; p <- 0.3
b <- matrix(rbinom(1e5 * n, 1, p), ncol = n)   # n Bernoulli(p) per row
c(var(rowSums(b)), n * p * (1 - p))
```

# Conditional expectation and the law of total expectation

```{r}
P <- matrix(c(.20,.10,.05, .15,.20,.10, .05,.05,.10), 3, byrow = TRUE)
x <- 0:2; py <- colSums(P)
m <- sapply(1:3, function(j) sum(x * P[, j]) / py[j])   # E[X | Y = y]
m                                      # 0.625 0.857 1.2
c(sum(m * py), sum(x * rowSums(P)))    # both 0.85
y <- rgamma(1e5, 2, 1); xx <- runif(1e5, 0, y)
c(mean(xx), mean(y / 2))               # both near 1
```

# Sums of independent normals and Poissons

```{r}
s <- rnorm(1e5, 25, 4) + rnorm(1e5, 18, 3)
c(mean(s), sd(s))                      # near 43 and 5
t <- rpois(1e5, 4) + rpois(1e5, 3)
c(mean(t == 0), dpois(0, 7))           # both near 0.0009
```
